Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command "
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
\\$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\('C:/Users/fangcheng612/AppData/Local/Temp/bunny_design.docx'\)
\\$entry = \\$zip.GetEntry\('word/document.xml'\)
\\$stream = \\$entry.Open\(\)
\\$reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\(\\$stream\)
\\$xml = \\$reader.ReadToEnd\(\)
\\$reader.Close\(\)
\\$stream.Close\(\)
\\$zip.Dispose\(\)
\\$xmlDoc = New-Object System.Xml.XmlDocument
\\$xmlDoc.LoadXml\(\\$xml\)
\\$ns = New-Object System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager\(\\$xmlDoc.NameTable\)
\\$ns.AddNamespace\('w', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'\)
foreach \(\\$p in \\$xmlDoc.SelectNodes\('//w:p', \\$ns\)\) {
    \\$text = ''
    foreach \(\\$t in \\$p.SelectNodes\('.//w:t', \\$ns\)\) {
        \\$text += \\$t.InnerText
    }
    if \(\\$text.Trim\(\) -ne ''\) {
        Write-Output \\$text
    }
}
" 2>&1)
